name: v0.dev AI app builder landing page by v0.dev
description: A near-monochrome landing page where the UI chrome is deliberately quiet — off-white canvas, black type, hairline gray borders — so the only saturated color arrives inside community template thumbnails and feature vignettes. The hero is a single centered prompt bar with suggestion chips, making the product itself the headline. Down the page, density rises through a three-column template gallery with fork/like metadata and a deliberately clipped final row, peaks in a nine-cell bento where each feature card carries its own illustrative miniature (icon clusters, a node diagram, a phone mockup), then relaxes through a grayscale logo marquee and a horizontal rail of tall mobile screenshots into a very airy centered CTA and four-column footer.
